newsitem.title: USA: Hirel Holdings restates Q2 to loss.
newsitem.headline: Hirel Holdings restates Q2 to loss.

text.p: Hirel Holdings Inc said on Monday it had restated its second quarter results, after reexamining certain adjustments to results made around the time of its July 22 initial public offering.

The company reported a revised loss of $202,530 or $0.05 per share for the quarter ended June 30 versus previously reported pro forma net income of $32,470 or $0.01 per share. In the second quarter 1995, the company reported a pro forma net income of $54,829 or $0.02 per share.
Hirel Holdings said after its initial public offering, it had made certain unnecessary adjustments to its second quarter results and had not made others that were necessary.
